title: "Data Integration"

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(batchelor)
library(bluster)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(scater)

rds.files <- list.files("./data/processedData", pattern = ".rds")

#######################
#Generating Seurat List
######################

seurat.list <- list()
for (i in seq_along(rds.files)) {
  seurat.list[[i]] <- readRDS(paste0("./data/processedData/", rds.files[i]))
  DefaultAssay(seurat.list[[i]]) <- "SCT"
}

seurat.list <- seurat.list[-107] # sample with a huge number of cells

#######################################
#Editing ADT Assay to make common names
#######################################

for (i in seq_along(seurat.list)) {
  orig.check <- unique(seurat.list[[i]]$orig.ident)
  if(orig.check %in% c(paste0("S", 31:44), "S54", "S55", "S121", "S122", "S125", "S126")) {
        rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@data) <- str_replace(rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT), "\\s*\\([^\\)]+\\)", "")
        rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@counts) <- str_replace(rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT), "\\s*\\([^\\)]+\\)", "")
        
    rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@data) <- stringr::str_remove_all(rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@counts), "CITE-")
        rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@counts) <- stringr::str_remove_all(rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@counts), "CITE-")
            
        rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@data) <- stringr::str_remove_all(rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@counts), "-TotalSeqC")
        rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@counts) <- stringr::str_remove_all(rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@counts), "-TotalSeqC")
        
        rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@data) <- stringr::str_remove_all(rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@counts), ",")
        rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@counts) <- stringr::str_remove_all(rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@counts), ",")
        rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@data) <- stringr::str_remove_all(rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@counts), "-")
        rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@counts) <- stringr::str_remove_all(rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@assays$ADT@counts), "-")
  }
}
saveRDS(seurat.list, "./data/seurat.list.rds")
######################
#Prepping Integration
#####################

#fastMNN() performance is highest on the variable gene
#Here we calculate the variable genes, and remove any 
#TCR-related genes and subset just the genes

seurat.list <- readRDS("./data/seurat.list.rds")
seurat.list <- PrepSCTIntegration(seurat.list)
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = seurat.list, nfeatures = 3000)
features <- Trex::quietTCRgenes(features) #removing any tcr genes from variable list

#fastMNN() works using individual samples and not
#in Seurat object, so here is convert
seurat.list <- lapply(seurat.list, function(x) {
  tmp <- subset(x,features = features)
  tmp <- as.SingleCellExperiment(tmp,
                                 assay = "SCT")
  tmp
})

#Running fastMNN()
out <- fastMNN(seurat.list)
saveRDS(out, "./data/fastMNN_output.rds")

##############################
#Calculating Nearest Neighbors
#############################

snn.gr <- makeSNNGraph(out@int_colData$reducedDims$corrected)
saveRDS(snn.gr, "./data/snn.graph.rds")
snn.cluster <- leiden.community(snn.gr)
saveRDS(snn.cluster, "./data/snn.cluster.rds")

knn.gr <- makeKNNGraph(out@int_colData$reducedDims$corrected)
saveRDS(knn.gr, "./data/knn.graph.rds")
knn.cluster <- leiden.community(knn.gr)
saveRDS(knn.cluster, "./data/knn.cluster.rds")

##################
#Calculating UMAP
#################

umap <- runUMAP(out, dimred="corrected")
saveRDS(umap, "./data/calculated.umap.rds")

#
##################
#Need to merge data here
#######################
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(sctransform)
source("./R/PrepSCT.R")

seurat.list <- readRDS("./data/seurat.list.rds")

for(i in seq_along(seurat.list)) {
  seurat.list[[i]] <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(seurat.list[[i]])
  DefaultAssay(seurat.list[[i]]) <- "SCT"
  seurat.list[[i]][["RNA"]] <- NULL
}

seurat.merge <- merge(seurat.list[[1]], seurat.list[-1])
saveRDS(seurat.merge, "./data/seurat.merged.rds")
meta <- seurat.merge[[]]
saveRDS(meta, "./data/meta.rds")

rm(seurat.list)




################
#Data Wrangling
################
seurat.merge <- readRDS("./data/seurat.merged.rds")
knn.cluster <- readRDS("./data/knn.cluster.rds")
snn.cluster <- readRDS("./data/snn.cluster.rds")
umap <- readRDS("./data/calculated.umap.rds")
seurat.merge$knn.leiden <- knn.cluster$membership
seurat.merge$snn.leiden <- snn.cluster$membership
umap <- CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = umap@int_colData$reducedDims@listData$UMAP, 
                            loadings = umap@int_colData$reducedDims@listData$UMAP, 
                            projected = umap@int_colData$reducedDims@listData$UMAP, 
                            assay = "SCT", 
                            key = "umap")
seurat.merge[["umap"]] <- umap

saveRDS(seurat.merge, "./data/seurat.merged.rds")

seurat.merge$simplified.labels <- seurat.merge$Monaco.labels
seurat.merge$simplified.labels[grepl("B cells",seurat.merge$Monaco.labels)] <- "B Cells"
seurat.merge$simplified.labels[grepl("T cells",seurat.merge$Monaco.labels)] <- "T Cells"
seurat.merge$simplified.labels[grepl("Th1|Th17|Th2|regulatory|MAIT",seurat.merge$Monaco.labels)] <- "T Cells"
seurat.merge$simplified.labels[grepl("dendritic cells",seurat.merge$Monaco.labels)] <- "Dendritic Cells" 
seurat.merge$simplified.labels[grepl("monocytes",seurat.merge$Monaco.labels)] <- "Monocytes" 
seurat.merge$simplified.labels[grepl("basophils|neutrophils",seurat.merge$Monaco.labels)] <- "Dendritic Cells" 

mycolors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(length(unique(seurat.merge$snn.leiden)))
plot1 <- DimPlot(seurat.merge, raster = FALSE, label = TRUE, group.by = "snn.leiden") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolors) + 
  guides(color = "none") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_blank())
plot2 <- DimPlot(seurat.merge, raster = FALSE, group.by = "orig.ident") + guides(color = "none") + 
  scale_color_viridis(option = "H", discrete = TRUE)+ 
  theme(plot.title = element_blank())
plot3 <- DimPlot(seurat.merge, raster = FALSE, group.by = "simplified.labels") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_blank())
plot1 + plot2 + plot3
ggsave("./output/data.preview.png", dpi = 300, height = 10, width = 30)
```

#################################
#Adding TCR data to Seurat Object
################################

A total of 290,491 cells with TCRs are recovered from sequencing, merging the cells contigs with the seurat object we recover 249,654 cells. This is due to possibly the mismatch in sequencing between VDJ and RNA, as well as the filtering of cells from the Seurat object for quality control.

```{r}
library(scRepertoire)

run_list <- list.files("./data/sequencingRuns")

file_list <- NULL
for(i in seq_along(run_list)) {
  x <- list.files(paste0("./data/sequencingRuns/", run_list[i]), "contig")
  if(length(x) == 1) {
    file <- paste0("./data/sequencingRuns/", run_list[i], "/", x)
    file_list <- c(file_list, file)
  }
}
recovered.runs <- stringr::str_split(file_list, "/", simplify = TRUE)[,4]

contig.list <- lapply(file_list, read.csv)

combined.TCR <- combineTCR(contig.list, 
                           samples = recovered.runs,
                           filterMulti = TRUE,
                           cells = "T-AB")



#seurat.merge <- readRDS("./data/seurat.merged.rds")
seurat.merge <- combineExpression(combined.TCR, seurat.merge)

seurat.merge$cloneType <- factor(seurat.merge$cloneType, levels = c("Rare (0 < X <= 1e-04)", "Small (1e-04 < X <= 0.001)", "Medium (0.001 < X <= 0.01)", "Large (0.01 < X <= 0.1)", "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)"))

DimPlot(seurat.merge, raster = FALSE, group.by = "cloneType") + guides(color = "none") + 
  scale_color_viridis(option = "B", discrete = TRUE, na.value = "grey")
ggsave("./output/clonotypeOverlay.png", dpi = 300, height = 10, width = 10)
saveRDS(seurat.merge, "./data/seurat.merged.rds")
```

####################
#Adding Patient Info
####################

```{r}
file.inventory <- readxl::read_xlsx("./summaryInfo/File.Inventory.xlsx")
meta <- seurat.merge[[]]
meta$barcode <- rownames(meta)
meta <- merge(meta, file.inventory, by.x = "orig.ident", by.y = "Sample")
barcodes <- meta$barcode
meta <- meta[,c(28:41)]
rownames(meta) <- barcodes
seurat.merge <- AddMetaData(seurat.merge, meta)

DimPlot(seurat.merge, group.by = "Tissue")
```
#########################
#Annotating the clusters
########################

Here is my attempt at annotating clusters (using the cluster.annotations.xlsx) and then generating a custom color palette

```{r}
#Adding the annotations to the meta data
cluster.annotation <- readxl::read_xlsx("./summaryInfo/cluster.annotations.xlsx")
meta.data <- seurat.merge[[]]
meta.data$barcode <- rownames(meta.data)
meta.data <- merge(meta.data, cluster.annotation, by.x = "snn.leiden", by.y = "Cluster")
barcodes <- meta.data$barcode
meta.data <- meta.data[,c("Annotation","Names")]
rownames(meta.data) <- barcodes
seurat.merge <- AddMetaData(seurat.merge, meta.data)

#Custom Color Palette
mycolors <- colorRampPalette(tableau_color_pal(palette = "Tableau 20")(20))(60)
cluster.names <- sort(unique(seurat.merge$Names))
color.combo <- c(mycolors[c(44,46)], mycolors[57], mycolors[c(32,34)], mycolors[c(26,28,29)], mycolors[1:4], mycolors[c(6,7,9)], mycolors[c(12:23)])
names(color.combo) <- cluster.names

Idents(seurat.merge) <- "Names"
DimPlot(seurat.merge, ) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = color.combo)
```
